policy: Budgets are measured per device tier. A regression against any static budget fails CI. Runtime targets (frame time, draw calls) are verified in browser profiling and reported here; they must not be silently relaxed.

mobile.description: Modern phone Chromium, capped interaction pixel ratio.

lowPower.description: Save-data or low-memory handset; battery quality profile.

runtimeTargets.firstSkeletalReadyMs: Measured from hbl-shell-mounted to hbl-skeletal-ready; reported from browser profiling, not asserted from static files.
runtimeTargets.contextLossRecovery: webglcontextlost must surface a recoverable state and webglcontextrestored must rebuild the scene without stale overlays (Phase 35 browser test).

lodPolicy: Distant LOD remains geometry-derived from the same source parts. A bounding-box proxy is acceptable only as a transient loading placeholder, never as the final visible representation of a selectable structure.
changelog: 2026-09-29: threeVendorKB 650->800 across tiers. Reason: Kinesiology Theater (Phase 68) adds lazily-loaded shared three.js helper geometry (GridHelper, Cylinder/Sphere/Circle geometries, hemisphere light). ~90 kB minified / ~23 kB gzip, lazy chunk only; per-tier runtime frame/draw-call/decoded-memory targets unchanged. Documented in docs/PROVENANCE_AUDIT_KINESIOLOGY.md; flagged for human review.
